Time really flies — Party Animals is officially turning TWO!

Huge thanks to all the players for your support, enthusiasm, and honest feedback. It’s your passion that keeps the world of Party Animals growing, evolving, and getting even more chaotic (in a good way)!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/8355a833aaf568729d0aa99859aa3d3aa785b477.png"]
In the year to come, we'll keep working hard to bring you even more creative maps, wild mechanics, and fresh chaos.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/87edd15c80b75b16c9485d9427042ee42b81fb96.png"]
During the day, the sun is warm and cozy. At night, the lights come on and the riverbank falls into a quiet calm.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37942853/636b5c0fdef98dab9fb0e15085b45dfe5b65e2d0.png"]

During his journey across the Party Animals world, explorer Nemo accidentally discovered a rift to a parallel universe — these worlds feel familiar, but everything's just a little… off.
Gravity-defying Ichiban, Typoon full of bombs, cats with giant heads, and dogs running around with balloons…

As the New Year approaches, the animals have lit a bonfire outside the cabin, with flickering flames reflecting off the pristine snow. A few little animals are having a snowball fight, with snowballs tracing arcs in the air. Everyone is busy planning how to decorate the cabin, aiming to give it a fresh look on the 20th.

The animals have donned their Christmas outfits, adding a festive touch to the winter season. These outfits will debut in the Item Shop on December 20th as limited-time holiday exclusives, lasting until January 3rd of the following year.
To celebrate Christmas, all newly released Christmas outfits will be available at a 50% discount when gifted to a friend!
Christmas outfits from previous years will also make a limited-time return from December 24th to December 26th!

Despite the cold, the animals remain full of excitement, racing on the newly constructed track. The course is still under construction, with construction vehicles and taxis occasionally disrupting the path, but that hasn’t dampened their enthusiasm. Eager to get started, they’ve already hit the road with new cars!
During the Christmas season, Snowmobile and Puppy will also receive new decorations. These will debut on the 20th as limited-time holiday exclusives, lasting until January 3rd of the following year.

On the familiar tracks of Nemo Kart, occasional snowstorms bring a seasonal twist. The entire tracks becomes blanketed in heavy snow. Amid this snowy wonderland, gingerbread men can be seen leisurely pacing in the distance. Their appearance raises curiosity—could they be preparing Christmas presents for everyone? Perhaps the next race will reveal the answer! (The snowstorm event starts on the 20th and lasts until February 3rd of the following year. The Christmas event starts on the 20th and lasts until January 3rd of the following year.)

Dear Players,

In the recent Cats vs. Dogs event, we heard a lot of frustration from players regarding the fact that the losing faction could not obtain the final outfit of the opposing faction. We fully understand this disappointment. As a result, we’ve made the following improvements to the final reward rules:
Players in the winning faction could obtain their own faction’s final outfit for free after reaching tier 30 in their faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
Players in the winning faction could purchase the opposing faction’s final outfit at a 60% discount after reaching tier 30 spying in the opposing faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
Players in the losing faction could purchase their own faction’s final outfit at a 60% discount after reaching tier 30 (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
Players in the losing faction could not obtain the opposing faction’s final outfit .
Players in both the winning and losing factions can obtain their own faction’s final outfit for free after reaching tier 30 in their faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
Players in the winning faction can obtain the opposing faction’s final outfit for free after reaching tier 30 spying in the opposing faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
Players in the losing faction can purchase the opposing faction’s final outfit at a 60% discount after reaching tier 30 spying in the opposing faction (with a gradual discount from tiers 1-30).
Players in the winning faction will unconditionally receive a special namecard that represents victory in the event.
Players in the winning faction can also obtain an upgraded version of their faction’s final outfit for free after reaching tier 30 (available only at tier 30 and above).

With these adjustments, we aim to give players from both factions the opportunity to obtain both factions' final outfits, while also providing additional rewards for the winning faction, such as the upgraded final outfit and the special victory namecard. We hope these changes will help bridge the reward gap between the two factions while ensuring that the winning side receives exclusive benefits.
We understand that the new rules may not address every concern, but we hope that this update will ease some of the frustration.
And thank you for playing Party Animals!

Ladies and gentlemen, cats and dogs, please allow me to introduce you to: **Nemo Kart (Beta)**

Nemo Kart is a brand new attempt by our development team, where players can choose their own animal and uniquely styled vehicles to compete on the track. Currently, the kart mode features a meticulously designed track. This track incorporates various challenges aimed at testing players' driving skills and strategic use.

Players can choose from different styles of karts, each with unique performance and design. Some karts have better cornering abilities, some earn higher acceleration bonuses from gear boosts, and others have stronger off-road capabilities...

By participating in Nemo Kart mode races, players can earn a game currency called "gears". These gears can be used to unlock new karts and special paint jobs. Each kart has several different paint options that not only change the vehicle's appearance but also reflect different racing personalities, such as being more aggressive or conservative.
Players can join Nemo Kart mode through quick match or custom games, currently accommodating up to 8 players or AI.

**Beta Phase Notes**: **Since the Nemo Kart mode is currently in the Beta testing phase, we are actively collecting player feedback to optimize vehicle balance and performance on specific hardware. We encourage players to report any issues or suggestions they encounter during their experience.**

We are actively preparing for our next content update, which is currently scheduled to be released at the end of January. The update includes a new Team Score map; a series of new characters and character skins; a complete redesign of the Winter Cabin map; and a beta test of the Friend Pass feature.
We've noticed that many players are looking for a place to chat with others, rather than just fight.

The new Winter Cabin map will provide a leisure space with less of an immediate goal, removing the win-by-points mechanism of the original mode, and adding a new tabletop game. The current plan is to increase the game duration of the Winter Cabin map to 30 minutes.
We hope the new Winter Cabin map will satisfy players who are interested in socializing and chatting. If you guys enjoy this space, we will consider adding more similar leisure modes in the future.

notes.title: A Series of New Characters and Outfits

items.text: Party Animals will welcome new characters and a series of outfits, replacing some of the old ones. So, if you have any outfits you're fond of, now's the time to grab them!
With the help of Steam, we've implemented a new feature: Friend Pass.
In essence, players who have purchased the game can invite one friend who hasn't purchased the game to join in the fun.

Currently, the Friend Pass version will only be available on the Steam platform, but full-version players on both Xbox and Steam can invite friends with the Friend Pass version to join their team or lobby.
The development team will test this feature in the update at the end of January. If everything goes well, we hope to keep this feature. After all, Party Animals is more fun with friends!
